title: Dust Release (Kekkei Tota)
body:
Dust Release (Kekkei Tota) forms from Earth + Fire + Wind. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 100: Particle Spear (help particle spear)
Level 100: Particle Cage (help particle cage)
Level 100: Atomic Dissolution (help atomic dissolution)
